summary: Comprehensive backend testing of Radharani Tours & Travels API. Created pytest suite with 23 tests covering auth, settings, seed data, bookings (with booking_id format and increment verification), admin CRUD (vehicles/destinations/tours/gallery/reviews), review approval filter, contact, and stats. All 23 tests passed against the external preview URL.

minor.issue: allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' (from default CORS_ORIGINS) is invalid per CORS spec; browsers will reject. Set explicit origins in backend/.env CORS_ORIGINS.
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting on repeated failed logins.
Uses full Settings model with defaults — a partial update omitting fields will silently reset them to defaults. Consider PATCH semantics.
No input length limits / spam protection on public contact endpoint.

action_items: Consider fixing CORS: replace '*' default with explicit origins when allow_credentials=True.
Optional: change /api/settings to accept partial updates to avoid resetting fields.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~594 lines — still manageable but approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider modularizing routes (auth/vehicles/bookings/admin) into separate routers.
seed() correctly upserts admin password when it doesn't match (idempotent) — good.
Booking counter uses find_one_and_update with $inc + upsert — atomic and idempotent (verified: sequential bookings increment by exactly 1).
CORS allow_credentials=True combined with wildcard '*' origin is invalid; must be explicit origins.
seed_data_creation: Verified pre-seeded: 3 vehicles (Aura, Ertiga, Eeco), 4 destinations (Agra, Delhi, Mathura, Vrindavan), admin user, default settings. Tests cleaned up any TEST_ prefixed data they created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green (23/23). Test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and Bearer token flow. Booking flow verified: POST /api/bookings returns RRT-YYYY-NNNN and counter increments atomically. Review filter (approved-only public / all admin) works. Stats endpoint returns all expected int counters. Only concerns are minor hardening items (CORS wildcard+credentials, no rate limit, PUT-not-PATCH on settings).
